$comment: P127 B2 cross-runtime types-core parity fixture: object and boxing, Type and typeof, int32 wraparound and checked, explicit conversions, casts, as and default. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result and `refuses` the error message it throws. Expected values match .NET 10 except where the spec makes NeoScript differ (string box identity, NeoScript type spelling). The web half runs through `neo test` (cli/src/commands/p127-types-parity.test.ts); the Unity half runs the same cases over a `neo export`. Vendor this file verbatim.
